purpose: Reusable templates for consultants, architects and developers working on real process, SAP, integration, data and AI problems.
usage_rule: Choose the smallest template that matches the problem. Fill evidence first, contradiction second, solution options third.

templates.name: Problem Framing Card
use_when: several teams describe the same problem differently
questions: What happens now, in plain language?
What useful outcome must remain?
Who is affected?
Which business object changes state?
What evidence do we already have?
What is inside and outside the problem boundary?
Which facts are known and which points are assumptions?
red_flags: problem described only as user dissatisfaction

templates.name: Contradiction Canvas
use_when: a design improves one KPI but damages another
questions: What do we want to improve?
What useful property becomes worse?
Why do we still need both properties?
Can the conflict be separated by time?
By condition?
By context?
By system level?
By authority?
By representation?
red_flags: one side of the contradiction is not useful
compromise accepted before separation is tested

templates.name: Business Process Redesign Canvas
questions: What useful function does each step protect?
Which steps only move information or responsibility?
Where is waiting created?
Which cases are normal and which are exceptions?
Which control must stay independent?
Can evidence or validation move earlier?
Can low-risk and high-risk cases follow different paths?
Which process state should become explicit?
What would we remove before automating?
red_flags: control removed without identifying the risk it protected

templates.name: Integration Decision Template
use_when: designing API, event or file integration
questions: Is this a command, query, notification or bulk transfer?
Does the caller need an immediate business confirmation?
Which system owns the durable state?
How fresh must the consumer view be for the actual decision?
Can the producer continue if the consumer is unavailable?
How are ordering, replay, duplicate delivery and idempotency handled?
Does the consumer need raw data or a purpose-specific representation?
What happens during partial failure?
Who owns monitoring and recovery?
red_flags: event used as remote procedure call

templates.name: SAP Change and Extension Template
questions: What business outcome is missing in the current design?
Can standard configuration solve the useful function?
Is the variation stable policy, local context or true custom behavior?
Where should the change live: configuration, in-app extension, developer extension or side-by-side service?
Which business object and lifecycle events are affected?
What data and authorization boundary is required?
What upgrade or ownership cost does the extension create?
What would make the change reversible?
How will we test the counter-effect on the standard process?
red_flags: local requirement embedded into global core without separation

templates.name: AI Use-Case Boundary Template
use_when: AI is proposed for a business process
RAG or an agent is considered
questions: What part of the problem is genuinely uncertain or interpretive?
Which exact rules should remain deterministic?
What can the model read?
What may it propose?
What must deterministic software validate?
Who or what approves a material action?
What narrow action can be executed?
What evidence is shown with the model output?
What is the stop condition for an agent loop?
How will quality, cost, latency and unsafe attempts be measured?

templates.name: Incident to Systemic Problem Template
questions: What useful function failed?
Which state became incorrect, missing or invisible?
Where was the first observable deviation?
Which retries, rejects, delays or overrides are useful signals?
Did recovery repair the cause or only restore the symptom?
Which boundary made diagnosis difficult?
What could make the failure observable earlier?
What change reduces recurrence without creating a new hidden dependency?
red_flags: root cause equals last error message
monitoring added without changing the failure mechanism

templates.name: Contradiction-Driven ADR Template
use_when: a technology decision has long-term cost
questions: What useful properties conflict?
Which separation operator changes the design space?
What is the remove-or-simplify option?
What is the deterministic redesign option?
Where does uncertainty justify AI, if anywhere?
Which option adds the lowest complexity tax?
Which assumptions could invalidate the decision?
What evidence will trigger a review of this ADR?
red_flags: ADR is only a technology choice
alternatives are different vendors for the same design

templates.name: Data and Master Data Governance Template
use_when: duplicate or poor master data causes process issues
global and local data needs conflict
questions: Which business decisions depend on this data?
Who owns the semantic definition?
Who may create, propose, approve and publish a change?
Which fields are global and which are contextual?
Which quality checks are exact and which need judgment?
Where should duplicate detection happen?
What representation does each consumer actually need?
How are changes distributed and reconciled?
Which quality metric has a business counter-metric such as lead time?
red_flags: one canonical view forced on every consumer

templates.name: Reversible Experiment Template
use_when: an option looks promising but evidence is weak
an AI or automation use case needs proof
questions: What exact hypothesis are we testing?
What is the smallest reversible change?
Which primary metric should improve?
Which useful property could become worse?
What counter-metric detects that damage?
What failure condition stops the experiment?
Can we use shadow, replay, one country, one interface or one low-risk class?
How do we roll back or recover?
What decision will be made after the experiment?
red_flags: experiment is already irreversible production rollout
